description: This file defines a TokenService class responsible for generating JWT tokens for authenticated users in the notes management system. It constructs the token with user claims, signing it with symmetric security key, and outputs the serialized token string.

classes.name: TokenService
classes.description: Service class for generating JWT tokens using user information and app settings.

methods.name: GenerateToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a JWT token string for a given user, embedding user ID, username, and email as claims, and signing the token with the configured secret.
